Subject guide

Live business programs and communication coaching

You may have a presentation coming up, a team conversation to prepare for, or a business idea you want to examine. Start with that situation, then find a program that addresses it.

Explore current programs↗

Bring a concrete question

Leadership, business, and communication cover a lot of ground. Think about the task you want to improve: structuring a presentation, explaining an idea, or practising a particular communication skill. Compare that task with the stated outcomes, rather than choosing only from a broad program title.

Choose between a group and a focused conversation

A program or workshop can offer a shared learning structure. Coaching, mentoring, or a consultation may be organised around a more focused topic. Do not infer the group size or level of personal attention from the format name alone. Read the program details and ask when something is unclear.

Read experience in context

Check the provider’s background, skills, current role, and portfolio where available. Look for experience connected to the subject you want to discuss. Reviews from completed enrollments can add context, but a rating alone does not explain whether the program suits your particular situation.

Look for specific learning outcomes

Look for outcomes you can recognise and practise. Review any preparation, materials, and session dates before paying. After enrollment, private messages give you a program-linked place for individual questions, while program discussion keeps group questions together. Use the right space for what you want to share.

Before you choose

A few things to check

  • Your specific learning goal
  • Format and group size
  • Relevant provider experience
  • Any preparation required

Current programs, prices, and dates are available in the app.

Choosing your program

Good questions
to ask.

Are consultations always one-to-one?

Check the individual program. Its capacity, description, and schedule should tell you how the session is organised.

Can I discuss a private question with the provider?

talent-share supports private, program-linked messages. Use those for individual questions, and clarify the scope of a consultation or coaching program before booking.
